title: Meeting Nabla

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You looking for Nabla, babe?

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Babe… we’re all Nabla. But you, you're Thaddeus's pet project. Took on a bar with a debt record longer than a budget trip to Luna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Babe… we’re all Nabla. But you, you're Thaddeus's pet project. Took on a bar with a debt record longer than a budget trip to Luna.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Don’t ask how Nabla knows. You’ll just embarrass yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don’t ask how Nabla knows. You’ll just embarrass yourself.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Nabla does a lot of things. Course Nabla doesn't buy from just anyone. You might be a Corpo grass for all Nabla knows.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nabla does a lot of things. Course Nabla doesn't buy from just anyone. You might be a Corpo grass for all Nabla knows.
Delivery job. Easy one.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Nabla needs a package delivered to Sage Hullen. You can find her hanging round Metro Hub.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nabla needs a package delivered to Sage Hullen. You can find her hanging round Metro Hub.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Here you go, babe. Come back when the job's done.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Then Nabla doesn't want to get involved with you. Later, BABE.

nodes.text: Babe. You NEVER ask what's in the package.

nodes.text: Either way, you're gonna have to prove yourself. Give a little, get a little.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Sure. We all believe that. What are you here for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. We all believe that. What are you here for?

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Eh... dying and failing in business is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh... dying and failing in business is.
